holder-quote: He had told Toren before imbuing him with [Limited Regeneration]. The skeleton had learned it as a Skill. He had gained several things from Az’kerash’s tinkering when he wasn’t teaching or creating new Chosen.
effect-quote: Among them, the ability to do this. A metatarsal that Toren needed was on a high shelf. So he tossed his arm up and grabbed it. His arm returned to his body. Like a Dullahan’s.

holder-quote: Toren could mend cracks or even fuse broken bones together with
effect-quote: mend cracks or even fuse broken bones together
